name: personal-os
description: Personal OS for the CXL AI Native Marketer cohort: project folders, daily logs written automatically, memory that travels with your folder, and the /personal-os:start, brief, ingest, shutdown, lint and team-update commands. Also includes guided setup for four AI visibility builds: /personal-os:aeo-qualitybuild-instructions, aeo-goingdeep-instructions, aeo-goingwide-instructions and aeo-baseline-instructions. Run /personal-os:setup in an empty folder to begin.
